title: Window measures on a numeric index column in metric views
body: Window measures support unitless `offset` and `trailing`/`leading` ranges on a consecutive integer `order` column. Use a numeric index for non-calendar periods such as fiscal weeks or 4-4-5 periods. See [Window measures on a numeric index column](/aws/en/uc-semantics/metric-views/advanced-techniques#numeric-index).
